title: #forge-eng: Memory leak and rotation crash both fixed

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: Two quick wins to start the week: camera memory leak (FORGE-29) and iOS 16 rotation crash (FORGE-28) both merged this morning. Instruments confirms zero memory growth on the camera path. iOS 16 crash is resolved with a layoutIfNeeded() deferral.

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: Haptics (FORGE-33) also merged. Three down early sprint. Now fully focused on tab bar and offline mode.

title: #forge-eng: Figma token sync — design lead comment on navigation

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: Heads up: the Figma token sync update (PR #23) has a comment from the design lead saying they've been experimenting with gesture-based navigation in the Forge v2 component file and it might change the nav architecture. I'm holding PR #23 until we understand whether this affects FORGE-30 (tab bar).

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: We decided on tab bar in sprint planning and the implementation is nearly done. A design experiment shouldn't reverse an engineering decision this late. I'll sync with the design lead directly. Tab bar is going in.

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: Offline mode (FORGE-32) sync strategy locked: foreground sync on app resume, with conflict resolution favoring server state. GRDB-backed SQLite cache. Implementation is 70% done — targeting completion this sprint. PR #24 up for early feedback.

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: The GRDB approach is solid. One thing to watch: App Group container access on extension targets — make sure the offline cache path works from the widget too (FORGE-31).
